Every visit, step by step

The Lawn Process

Every cut. Every edge. Every detail.

Scroll to follow a visit

  1. 01 / Cutting

    Precision in every pass.

    We mow with a 30-inch Toro TurfMaster commercial mower. Its wide twin-blade deck covers more lawn in every pass and lays down clean, straight stripes.

  2. 02 / Trimming

    No detail overlooked.

    Next, the STIHL FS 111 R string trimmer handles everything the mower can’t reach: around trees, along fences and garden beds, and beside the house.

  3. 03 / Sidewalk & garden bed edging

    Clean lines. Every time.

    We turn the STIHL FS 111 R on its side and edge your sidewalk and garden beds vertically, cutting a crisp, defined line between the lawn and everything around it.

  4. 04 / Blowing

    We leave your property spotless.

    Finally, a STIHL BR 600 backpack blower clears every hard surface — driveway, sidewalk, walkways and steps — so no clippings are left behind.

  5. 05 / The finished result

    Your lawn. At its best.

    Straight stripes, trimmed corners, sharp edges and clean surfaces. Every visit.
